scenes.basis: 16:1 "He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy"; 16:2 "The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him" - Timothy is found at Lystra; Derbe is the arrival leg
16:8 "Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas" - the regions of Phrygia, Galatia and Mysia and the Bithynia attempt are the blocked route, never settings
16:9 "A vision appeared to Paul in the night" - the night vision names no place; it follows the Troas arrival of 16:8; Macedonia is the vision's destination, not a setting
16:11-12 "Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis; and from there to Philippi" ; 16:12 "We were staying some days in this city"
16:13 "On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together"

16:19 "they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers"; 16:23 "When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison"; 16:40 "They went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia’s house"
